prompt: Create a clean anime-style half-body portrait of a young woman centered on a plain white background. She has medium chestnut brown shoulder-length hair with soft layered ends, side-swept bangs, loose flyaway strands on both sides, and glossy highlight strokes. Her face is gentle and youthful with large warm brown eyes, bright white eye highlights, thin lashes, soft eyebrows, a tiny nose, a small closed smile, and faint pink blush lines on both cheeks. She is looking directly at the viewer with a slight head tilt and relaxed posture. Dress her in a simple cream long-sleeve blouse with a modest split neckline and soft fabric folds, tucked into a high-waisted dark navy skirt or waistband visible at the bottom of the frame. Use polished Japanese anime illustration style: clean dark line art, smooth cel shading, warm skin tones, subtle shadows under the chin and in the clothing folds, crisp details in the hair and eyes, no text, no props, no scenery, no watermark. Portrait composition, cropped from head to upper waist, with the character occupying most of the canvas.

promptZh: 创作一张简洁的动漫风格半身肖像，画面中心为一名年轻女性，背景为纯白色。她留着 中栗棕色 的齐肩发，发尾层次柔和，带有侧分刘海，两侧有零散的发丝，并带有光泽感的高光笔触。她的面容温柔年轻，拥有一双温暖的大棕色眼睛，明亮的白色瞳孔高光，纤细的睫毛，柔和的眉毛，小巧的鼻子，微微闭合的嘴唇带着浅笑，双颊带有淡淡的粉色腮红。她微微歪头，姿态放松，直视前方。她身穿一件简约的米色长袖衬衫，领口设计简洁，衣褶柔和，下摆束进高腰深海军蓝裙子或腰带中（画面底部可见）。采用精致的日式动漫插画风格：线条清晰利落，赛璐珞风格平涂，肤色温暖，下巴和衣褶处有细腻的阴影，头发和眼睛细节清晰，无文字，无道具，无背景，无水印。肖像构图，从头部到上腰部裁剪，角色占据画布大部分空间。
